sentences.text:
Officer, ... on 13 September, 2024
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C.V.Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.19143 of 2014
Order:

This Writ Petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, is filed by the petitioner, seeking the following relief:
"....to issue an order direction or an appropriate Writ more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus directing the respondents to pay the petitioners the compensation at the present market value with interest thereon for the 20 guntas of Land in Survey No.150 of Sattupalli Village, Sattupalli Mandal, Khammam District acquitted by the respondents on behalf of the Roads and Buildings Department for Road widening and pass..."
2.

The case of the petitioners is that their father, late Alluri Suryaprakash Rao, was the owner and possessor of the land admeasuring Ac.0.20 gts. in Sy.No.150 situated opposite Ramalayam on the main road of Sathupalli Village, Sathupalli Mandal, Khammam District.

It is the further case of the petitioners that their father died intestate on 14.08.1980 at Kothegudem, Khammam District,
leaving the petitioners as his successors and legal representatives.

It is the further case of the petitioners that respondent No.1 acquired the said land for the purpose of widening the main road under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short, "the Act").

It is their case that while issuing notification under Section 4(1) of the Act, the respondents have not issued any notice to the 2 CVBR,J wp_19143_2014 petitioners and no enquiry as such, was conducted under the provisions of the Act to determine the compensation payable to the petitioners.

It is their case that having come to know that their land has been acquired, they made several representations to the respondents, including the District Collector, Khammam District, to pay the compensation at the present market value with interest thereon for the land acquired.
The grievance of the petitioners is that even after receiving the said representations, the respondents have not taken any action thereon.
3. This Writ Petition is pending on the file of this Court since 2014.
The respondents have not filed any counter affidavit.

4. Except stating that the petitioners are the owners of the said land relying upon the entries made in pahani, the petitioners have not filed any document in support of their claim that they are the owners and possessors of the land, which is alleged to have been acquired by the respondents for the purpose of road widening.
In the absence of any documents filed by the petitioners, they are not entitled for payment of compensation under the provisions of the Act.

on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96226616/
1
petitioners are permitted to submit a representation to the respondents, by duly enclosing all the documents to establish that they are the owners of the land to an extent of Ac.0.20 gts.

in Sy.No.150 situated opposite to Ramalayam on the main road of Sathupalli Village, Sathupalli Mandal,
Khammam District.

On receipt of such application, the respondents are directed to conduct survey and to initiate appropriate action for payment of compensation in accordance with law if it is found that the petitioners' land has been affected in the road widening.
5. With the above observations, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.
